title: opencode-okf config
description: Configuration for the opencode-okf plugin (OKF knowledge bundles: progressive disclosure + auto-unload). Place in ~/.config/opencode/okf.jsonc (global) or <project>/.opencode/okf.jsonc (project overrides).

enabled.description: Auto-scan the project root for OKF bundles.

ignore.description: Additional directory names to skip during scan.

bundles.description: Explicit bundles to load (merged with auto-scan; takes precedence on conflicts).

path.description: Path to the bundle root (relative to project, or absolute).

name.description: Display name for the bundle. Defaults to the directory basename.

injectManifest.description: Inject a compact bundle manifest (L0) into the system prompt.

maxManifestChars.description: Hard cap on the manifest length injected into the system prompt.

unload.description: Controls auto-unloading of loaded OKF concepts to keep the context lean.

afterTurns.description: Replace a loaded concept's output with a placeholder after this many user turns.

keepRecent.description: Always keep the N most recent okf_read outputs, never auto-unload them.

placeholder.description: "description" keeps title+type+description; "minimal" keeps just a reload hint.

nudge.description: Soft reminders (anchored to the last user message) when a lot of OKF knowledge is loaded.

threshold.description: Total chars of loaded-and-not-unloaded concepts above which a nudge is injected.

frequency.description: Inject the nudge at most once every N user messages.

force.description: Nudge tone. "soft" = a gentle suggestion; "strong" = a directive that frames unloading as a context-quality necessity.

updateIndex.description: Add/update the entry in the parent directory's index.md.

appendLog.description: Prepend an entry under today's date heading to log.md.

protectedConcepts.description: Glob patterns of concept ids that are never auto-unloaded (e.g. "tables/*"). Matches against the id and against "bundleName::id".
